name: io.github.IvanBBaev/facebook-mcp
description: Facebook Pages MCP server for the Meta Graph API — identity, Page discovery, rate-limit diagnostics

environmentVariables.name: FB_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Primary user or system-user access token. At least one of FB_ACCESS_TOKEN, FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN or FB_PAGE_TOKEN must be set.

environmentVariables.name: FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: System-user access token (Business Manager); takes precedence over FB_PAGE_TOKEN when both are set.

environmentVariables.name: FB_PAGE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Long-lived Page access token used as a fallback credential.

environmentVariables.name: FB_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Meta app ID; combined with FB_APP_SECRET to authorize token inspection and sign calls.

environmentVariables.name: FB_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Meta app secret; enables appsecret_proof so a stolen bare token cannot be used.

environmentVariables.name: FB_PAGE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default Facebook Page ID, used when a tool call omits an explicit profile.

environmentVariables.name: FB_API_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Graph API version to target. Defaults to the tested pinned version.

environmentVariables.name: FB_WRITE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Write gating mode: plan (validating dry-run preview, default) or apply.

environmentVariables.name: FB_TOOL_PACKAGES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool packages to expose (e.g. core,posts,reader); omit for the default profile.

environmentVariables.name: FB_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token guarding the HTTP transport; required when FB_TRANSPORT=http (fails closed without it).

environmentVariables.name: FB_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port for the HTTP transport (loopback only); used when FB_TRANSPORT=http.

environmentVariables.name: FB_MEDIA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory permitted for local media uploads; unset means URL-only, local file access disabled.

environmentVariables.name: FB_CONFIRM_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Operator confirmation token for out-of-band approval of destructive or spend actions when elicitation is unavailable.
